data.one_liner: An HTTP inspector widget and interceptor for Dio to log and view requests, responses, and errors.
data.what_it_does: It catches HTTP requests, responses, and errors made via Dio using an interceptor and displays them in a dedicated widget view. Developers can view request details and copy cURL commands directly from the UI.
use_when: You are using the Dio package for networking in your Flutter app.
You need a visual debugging tool to inspect HTTP traffic during development.
avoid_when: You are not using Dio for your network requests.
You require a network inspector that operates completely outside the widget tree without custom UI views.
strengths: Allows viewing and copying cURL commands for every request.
Provides a built-in UI view (`FancyDioInspectorView`) for easy integration.
weaknesses: Tied specifically to the Dio HTTP client.
UI inspector view must be manually added to your widget tree.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency, add FancyDioInterceptor to your Dio instance, and place FancyDioInspectorView in your widget tree.

alternatives.name: pretty_dio_logger
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer console-only logging for Dio requests rather than an in-app visual inspector widget.

alternatives.name: inspector
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need a general-purpose debugging and inspection suite.
